**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good:
- Diff is exactly `README.md` (+2 lines) and the new root `screenshot.png`. `.gitignore` is unchanged; the PNG is force-added, as the body explains.
- The image line sits after the opening description and before `## What it does`, uses the relative path `screenshot.png`, and has plain-English alt text.
- Nothing under `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/` changed, and no process file (`AGENTS.md`, `.claude/`, `xtask/`, `.cargo/`, `scripts/`) changed.
- Body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #1276`. No other closing keyword.
- `mergeable: MERGEABLE`, not a draft.
- The image is 363,431 bytes (about 363 KB), within the size guideline.

Local results: docs-only change, so no build, test or clippy run (per the issue).

Requested before merge: nothing.

Notes (not blocking): the two commits carry the same subject line; the squash-free merge will keep both, which is fine under the merge-commit rule.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
